statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r equals the number of pairs (i, j) of indices such that 0 <= i < j < len(nums) and |nums[i] - nums[j]| == k, where |x| = x if x >= 0 and |x| = -x if x < 0.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 200; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100; 0 <= k <= 99.

statement: The function returns a result r (it does not fail, panic, or overflow) for every input satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 200; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100; 0 <= k <= 99.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, 0 <= r <= len(nums) * (len(nums) - 1) / 2.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 200; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100; 0 <= k <= 99.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = sum_{v=1}^{100} (f(v) * (f(v) - 1) / 2), where f(v) is the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = v.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 200; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100; and k = 0.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = 0.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 200; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100; 0 <= k <= 99; and k > max(nums) - min(nums), where max(nums) and min(nums) are the maximum and minimum values in nums.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r > 0 if and only if there exist indices i and j such that 0 <= i < j < len(nums) and |nums[i] - nums[j]| == k.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 200; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100; 0 <= k <= 99.

statement: Whenever count_k_difference(nums, k) returns r and count_k_difference(nums', k) returns r', we have r = r'.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 200; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100; 0 <= k <= 99; and for another slice nums': 1 <= len(nums') <= 200; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums'), 1 <= nums'[i] <= 100; len(nums') = len(nums); and there exists an integer c such that nums'[i] = nums[i] + c for all 0 <= i < len(nums).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = sum_{v=1}^{100} f(v) * f(v + k), where f(x) is the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = x, and f(x) = 0 for x outside 1..100.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 200; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100; and k > 0 with 0 <= k <= 99.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, 2 * r equals the number of ordered pairs (i, j) of indices such that 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= j < len(nums), i != j, and |nums[i] - nums[j]| == k.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 200; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100; 0 <= k <= 99.

statement: Let flip be the slice of length len(nums) defined by flip[i] = 101 - nums[i] for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums). Whenever count_k_difference(nums, k) returns r and count_k_difference(flip, k) returns r', we have r = r'.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 200; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100; 0 <= k <= 99.
